records.name: Pasión y Arte Flamenco
records.summary: A Philadelphia flamenco dance company that teaches classes and stages shows, festivals and tablao nights. Its fall and winter classes are listed on its own site.
records.what_you_do: Take flamenco classes, or go to a performance or festival listed on the company's calendar.

schedule.text: Fall and winter classes for 2026 are posted on the Classes page. Performances are listed on the site's calendar and upcoming events pages.

first_step.how: Open the Classes page on the company's site for the fall and winter 2026 schedule and sign-up steps
first_step.basis: Classes are announced, but levels, times and sign-up steps were not on the pages I could read, so the way in is unclear

records.notes: Legal name on GuideStar is Pasion Y Arte Inc. The site's newest dated item is a banner reading Fall/Winter Classes 2026, which gives the year but no month, so last_sign_of_life is left out. A 6abc article dated 2024-10-08 covers the company, so the newest evidence is the 2026 banner. Class location is not stated; the Overbrook address is the listed office. The site has no email or phone, only a contact page. Lead name was Pasion y Arte Flamenco Inc.

records.name: Park Avenue Community Center Inc
records.notes: The center is at 129 Park Ave, Swarthmore, PA 19081, in Delaware County, per the Amilia store page and the Benevity cause page. It is outside Philadelphia. The group's own site returned no content when fetched twice, so the location comes from those two pages. Not published.

records.name: The Players Club of Swarthmore
records.notes: The theater building is at 614 Fairview Rd in Springfield Township, Delaware County, per the Philadelphia Architects and Buildings record. That is outside Philadelphia. No own site was found in one search. Not published.

records.name: Plays & Players Theatre
records.summary: A membership collective of theatre people at 1714 Delancey Place. It runs public shows, comedy nights, open mics, readings and a gallery, and members produce some of the shows.
records.what_you_do: Buy a ticket to a show, comedy night or reading, come to an open mic, or join as a member to take part in the collective.

schedule.text: Public shows, comedy nights, open mics and readings run through October and November, most at 8 pm, many at Quig's Pub. The site lists each date.

cost.text: Ticket prices vary by event and are sold through links on the site. No general price is given.

first_step.how: Pick a public event on the site and buy a ticket, or follow the membership info link to join
first_step.basis: Shows, open mics and readings are open to anyone with a posted date and a ticket link

records.notes: The old playsandplayers.org address redirects to playsandplayerstheatre.org. The page gives month and day only. The year 2026 comes from an Eventbrite ticket link on the page. No classes, youth programs or volunteer roles are listed on the page, so none are recorded. Lead name was Plays & Players Theatre.

records.name: Twelve Gates Arts
records.summary: A gallery in Old City that shows contemporary art connected to South Asia and its diaspora. It holds exhibition openings, public talks, screenings and a residency for emerging artists.
records.what_you_do: Visit the gallery during open hours, or go to an opening, talk or screening listed on the site.

schedule.text: Gallery hours are Wednesday 12 to 6 pm and Thursday to Saturday 11 to 5 pm. Fall 2026 events are listed by date on the site, including an exhibition running October 2 to 15, 2026 and talks in September and October.

cost.text: The page does not say whether gallery visits are free. A student showcase is listed at $40, and some events have tickets.

first_step.how: Come to an exhibition opening or a public talk listed on the site, or call the gallery at (215) 253-8578
first_step.basis: Exhibitions and events are open to the public on posted hours. The site gives no beginner-specific programs.

records.notes: The site gives two ZIP codes, 19106 in the header and 19104 in the footer, and the older Idealist listing gives 51 N 2nd St. The record uses the site's 106 North 2nd Street. Email is not published; the site uses a contact form. Sunday to Tuesday hours are not listed. The October 29 screening is at 4017 Walnut St, a different venue. The Residency and Workshops pages are linked but were not read.

records.name: Storybook Musical Theatre
records.summary: A children's theatre company that stages family musicals based on fairy tales and classic children's books. It runs a season of shows from winter to summer and also offers theatre classes.
records.what_you_do: See a family musical, take a theatre class, or audition for a show, using the class and audition pages on the site.

schedule.text: The 2026 to 2027 season runs in short runs: December 17 to 30, 2026; March 9 to 20, 2027; May 4 to 16, 2027; and July 13 to 24, 2027. Class and audition dates are on the linked pages.

cost.text: Prices are not on the page. Tickets are sold through a linked ticket page.

first_step.how: Buy tickets through the site's ticket link, or check the Theater Classes and 2026 to 2027 Auditions pages
first_step.basis: Classes and auditions are linked, but the pages I could read gave no dates, fees or requirements, so the way in is unclear

records.notes: The site does not name the venue for the 2026 to 2027 shows. The company's mailing address is PO Box 473, Abington, PA 19001, which is outside the city. Older listings put shows at Gratz College in Melrose Park and at the Bluett Theater at St. Joseph's University in the city, so it serves the Philadelphia area. Confirm the current venue before go-live. Kind is set to program because the site does not state its legal status. Community_theater is the closest tag for a professional company. The Walk On Role and class photo pages appear in the menu but were not read. The September 2026 date is a parent testimonial on the site. Lead name was Storybook Musical Theatre.

records.name: United Caribbean Association of Philadelphia
records.summary: A nonprofit that runs the Philly Caribbean Carnival, a festival in Fairmount Park that celebrates Caribbean heritage with music, costumes and community programs.
records.what_you_do: Buy a carnival ticket, or email the group to ask how to volunteer or join.

schedule.text: The 2026 carnival was held in Fairmount Park. The 2026 ticket page gives the year but no day. The group is already asking for donations toward 2027.

cost.text: 2026 carnival tickets ranged from $15 to $30 on the ticket page, and some tiers had sold out.

first_step.how: Buy a ticket for the carnival, or email ucaphila@gmail.com to ask about joining or volunteering
first_step.basis: The carnival is open to the public on posted tickets, but the site gives no steps for volunteering or joining

records.notes: The own site says the group is a registered 501(c)(3) and runs the carnival under the Philly Carnival name. The ticket page and the own site do not give a day for the 2026 carnival. The site's Join Us button leads to a page with no detail. The copyright footer year is not used as evidence. Calling the carnival recurring is an inference from the 2027 fundraising call; confirm it. The City of Philadelphia article of June 23, 2026 names the group's president. Lead name was United Caribbean Association of Philadelphia.

records.name: PlayArts
records.notes: A commercial drop-in play space for young children at 1241 N Front St in Fishtown, per a Time Out review dated February 2018. The review describes drop-in visits and membership but no community program, classes or volunteer roles, and it does not say whether the space is a business or a nonprofit. Hidden as a business with no community program found. No own site was found in one search. Newest source is from 2018.

leads_only.name: Journey Arts
leads_only.note: Arts nonprofit at 701 S. 50th Street, Philadelphia, named on the Pasión y Arte event page as the host of its performance. Runs its own events and education programs. Not checked.

leads_only.name: Caribbean United Leaders Collective
leads_only.note: Named in the City of Philadelphia article of June 23, 2026 as a collective that the UCAP president belongs to. No link found. Not checked.

leads_only.name: Contemporary West Dance Theatre
leads_only.note: Listed as a visiting company at Plays & Players Theatre on October 2 and 3, 2026. No link found. Not checked.

blocked.note: Returned HTTP 503 on two attempts. Presente! Media was dropped, see notes.
Returned no page content on two attempts. Location was confirmed from the Amilia store and Benevity pages instead.

notes: All 12 names were searched once each and the search budget (12 of 12) is spent. Results: 5 publish, 2 out_of_area (Park Avenue Community Center is in Swarthmore, Delaware County; Players Club of Swarthmore is in Springfield Township, Delaware County), 1 hide (PlayArts, a commercial drop-in play space). Four leads were dropped with no record. Philly Drum Project: its own domain, phillydrumproject.com, is now a for-sale page, and the newest press is from 2015, so it is dormant and not recorded. Philly Slam League: the search returned only unrelated leagues and events, so nothing was recorded. Rittenhouse Sound Chorus (Philadelphia Chapter Barbershop Harmony Society): no chorus by that name was found, the search hit a Rittenhouse studio that is not a chorus, and the Cultural Alliance profile is blocked. Presente! Media: no own site was found, the Good Pitch page returned 503 twice, and the only dated evidence is a 2020 event listing. The input lead URLs are Cultural Alliance portal listings, which are blocked, so each lead was searched by name instead. Caveats for review: the Storybook Musical Theatre venue is not published, and the Plays & Players year comes from a ticket link on the page. The Pasión y Arte record has no last_sign_of_life because its newest dated item gives only the year.
